source.author: hor
source.text: siquid tamen olim scripseris, in Meti descendat iudicis auris et patris et nostras nonumque prematur in annum membranis intus positis: delere licebit, quod non edideris, nescit vox missa reverti.
source.text_original: siquid tamen olim  / scripseris, in Meti descendat iudicis auris  / et patris et nostras nonumque prematur in annum  / membranis intus positis: delere licebit,  / quod non edideris, nescit vox missa reverti.
source.text_english: Still, if ever you write anything, let it descend into the ears of the judge, the father, and ours at Meti; and let it be kept for the ninth year, the tablets laid aside within. You may erase what you have not published; a voice once sent forth does not know how to return.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: in hac quoque prouincia iam libri fuerant diuulgati et, ut ipse legisti, nescit uox missa reuerti.
reuse.text_original: in hac quoque prouincia iam libri fuerant diuulgati et, ut ipse legisti, nescit uox missa reuerti.
reuse.text_english: In this province too books had already been circulated, and, as you yourself have read, a voice once sent out does not know how to return.
